periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the primary axes of the patches tilted inward and downward toward the muzzle at approximately a 45-degree angle from the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval morphology where the vertical dimension is notably greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward expansion, creating a teardrop-like appearance with a larger mass below the midline of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curvature along the posterior margin where the black dorsal band meets the white lumbar fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Extensive thickness covering the entire shoulder mantle and extending down the forelimbs.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral displacement on the superior-lateral aspects of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex hemispherical curvature at the superior apex of the pinnae.
